notes.source: The app chrome’s tab bar, in both clients (#647). The three destinations are the site’s own primary routes (`frontend/ui/navbar/route-kind.ts`), so their labels are the site’s labels rather than a second naming of the same screens. `npm run copy:generate` writes both files from this one; neither client may spell these strings itself.
notes.gate: `npm run check:copy` fails a stale generated output, and `npm run check:parity` fails a key the reference component (`frontend/ui/navbar/BottomTabBar.tsx`) does not render — the site is the design the app is measured against.
